name: Oracle — Subject (what)
description:
When to use: The noun or focus of the prompt. Often combined with Action and Adjective into one prompt.

How to read it: Pick any synonym from the list that fits, blend them, or reinterpret for your setting. Re-roll or ignore if nothing sparks.
